description: Side-by-side numbers for several links, ranked by attention (reading time, then opens): opens, unique viewers, reading time, average per session and completion within the window. Give ids, or a query that matches file names (e.g. 'proposal'). Use it for 'which of my proposals got the most attention this month?'.

ids.description: Link ids or tokens to compare (max 20).

query.description: Compare every link whose file name, id or label contains this text.

since.description: Time window: 24h, 7d, 30d, 4w, today, yesterday, all, or an ISO date/datetime such as 2026-10-01 (UTC unless an offset is given). Default 30d.

name: compare_links
title: Compare links side by side
